data.narrative:
CuspAI is a Series A-stage AI & Software company founded by Max Welling and Chad Edwards that has raised over $100M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 private companies at Series A and adjacent Series B stages, supplemented by 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and reference to a broader frontier-tech peer universe including Reflection AI, Together AI, Waymo, and Figure AI.

Two valuation methods triangulate a range. The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $100M total raised proxy, implying a $200M valuation. The Peer-Median method anchors to 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $7.0B (range: $3.2B to $25.0B), comprising Reflection AI at $25.0B, Together AI at $8.3B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, and Black Forest Labs at $3.2B.

Triangulation yields a low-to-high range of $170M to $8.0B, with a median of $3.6B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in peer selection and comparability. Stage-Progression implies $200M, likely an underestimate given the company's $100M+ capital base and frontier-tech market conditions. Peer-Median at $7.0B reflects the sector's valuation profile but depends critically on whether CuspAI's competitive position and stage justify positioning toward the upper or lower end of the peer range. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, competitive defensibility, and path to Series B.
